title: feat(spec)!: retire the boolean arm of a relationship field's inlineEdit, which read as absent once a parent field group decides the placement
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As5bdhV5T4N9vpjmZzH
Fixes #35926

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: follow-up #37042

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：写元数据的人（包括 AI 搭建）在主从或查找字段上写「内联编辑」为真或假时，校验直接报错并写出改法；已经存下来的旧定义在启动和迁移时自动去掉这个值，页面表现不变。字段设计器里多了一个「表格 / 表单」下拉框来选子表的编辑方式。
- 为什么做：维护者裁定「一律只看分组」之后，子表进不进父表单只由父对象的字段分组决定，这两个真假值读起来和不写完全一样，属于写了没用的键（记录页重做专题的收尾）。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是有人在源码里写了真假值，升级后校验被拒并看到改法；已存数据走自动转换，不会坏页面。撤回即还原本改动。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

Per the maintainer's field-group ruling on #35889 (record 7046311205, 「一律只看分组」), a field group of the parent decides whether the parent's form inlines a child, so a relationship field's `inlineEdit` only picks the form factor of a placed child. Measured on `origin/main` e343ab7c, every reader passes anything but `'grid'` / `'form'` as absent:

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx` (`attachInlineSubforms`): `d.inlineEdit === 'grid' || d.inlineEdit === 'form' ? d.inlineEdit : undefined`;
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/deriveMasterDetail.ts` `resolveInlineMode`: `true` / `false` / `undefined` all take the smart default;
- `packages/lint/src/validate-field-consumers.ts` `formFactorOf`: `undefined` for anything else;
- the lint rules R5 / R6 (`data-model-rules.ts`) no longer read the value at all.

So `false` reads exactly as absent too, and the whole boolean arm is retired, not only `true`. One non-runtime reader treats `true` differently, the scenario scorer; see Acceptance notes.

- **`@objectstack/spec`**: `FieldSchema.inlineEdit` narrows from `boolean | 'grid' | 'form'` to `z.enum(['grid', 'form'])`, and the enum's own error map answers a boolean with the prescription (`INLINE_EDIT_BOOLEAN_RETIRED`, house five-part shape and `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence). `tsc` refuses a boolean at every typed site. The route is a value narrowing like `indexes[].unique: true` (the same refusal-by-error-map precedent): `enumWithRetiredValues` takes string members only, so it cannot name a boolean arm.
- **ADR-0087**: D2 conversion `field-inline-edit-boolean-removed` (lossless delete of a boolean on `objects[]` / `objectExtensions[]` field maps, `retiredFromLoadPath: true`, `retiredAfter: '18.6.0'`), in `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` at order 84; D3 semantic entry `field-inline-edit-boolean-retired`; a step-18 rationale fragment; a JOIN row in `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts`. No `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR` row: the key is not tombstoned.
- **Liveness**: `field.json` `inlineEdit` stays `live` for the two surviving values, now with `verifiedAt`, in-repo evidence and the narrowing in its note. State counts unchanged.
- **Field form**: with the union gone, a select spells every value, so the omit row "no registered widget spells this union" no longer holds. The field form offers `inlineEdit` as a Grid / Form select on `lookup` / `master_detail`; the reconciliation ledger drops the row and the ruled class drops `field.inlineEdit`, as that test's own header prescribes for "a ruled key that a form offers later". i18n bundles regenerated (`check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`), zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES translated by hand; the echo-decisions count pin carries one more row label (772 after the main merge).
- **`relatedList` prose** kept true: it no longer calls itself "the read-side mirror of inlineEdit" but "the record-page side; inlineEdit picks the form factor on the form side".
- **Authored values**: the CLI golden metadata-eval corpus places its line items with a parent field group (`fieldGroups[].relatedList`) instead of `inlineEdit: true`, since each prompt asks for lines entered with the parent; test fixtures in spec, cli and app-shell are respelled to `'grid'` or the key is dropped. Docs (`field-types.mdx`, `fields.mdx`, `common-patterns.mdx`, `flows.mdx`) teach `'grid' | 'form'`. Stale comments in `project.view.ts`, `deriveRelatedLists.ts`, `validate-field-consumers.ts`, `score.ts` fixed.
- Changeset `.changeset/35926-field-inline-edit-boolean-retired.md` (spec minor, cli patch, platform-objects patch) with FROM → TO table and ADR-0087 disposition.

File-surface notes: the claim listed `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/views/task.view.ts` and `packages/lint/src/showcase-shape.fixtures.ts`; both carry the VIEW-level `inlineEdit` (a different, live key) and are untouched. Producer-side files outside the listed surface, each a direct consequence of the narrowing: `field.form.ts`, `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`, the platform-objects translation bundles and their count pin, cli `score.ts` comment and four cli tests, the app-shell inspector test.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/data/field-inline-edit-boolean.pin.test.ts` (14): `true` / `false` refused at `inlineEdit` with `invalid_value` and the prescription; `'grid'`, `'form'`, absent parse; an unknown string keeps zod's own message; `@ts-expect-error` on a typed boolean; the conversion deletes a boolean on both collections and leaves `'grid'` / `'form'`; step-18 wiring.
- No tree-scoped absence pin: the view-level `inlineEdit` is a live boolean key of the same name, so a text scan cannot tell the retired spelling from the live one. The sweep is the input type and the parse.

Since #35889 `inlineEdit` alone inlines nothing, and since this PR a boolean is refused at parse, so that branch can only see an unparsed stack. Not changed here; noted for the eval seat.
